verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own workflows run unattended in the background: multi-action steps (reminders, CRM updates, to-dos, webhooks) fire at set times before or after meetings, follow reschedules, are called off on cancellation, and can auto-attach to new links. Their scope is limited to booking and meeting-lifecycle triggers, with no general recurring schedules or AI-driven autonomous behavior documented. Missing for 10: automations not tied to meeting events (independent recurring schedules), agentic or AI-driven decision-making within automations, workflow-level run history or monitoring beyond the webhook request log, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks with SavvyCal workflows
Keep your automations neatly organized with powerful multi-action workflows.
To run your code at a set time before or after a meeting, use a workflow's Send a webhook action.
Reschedule, and the steps still to come move to the new time. Cancel, and they're called off.
Turn on "Automatically attach to new links," and every link you create from then on picks it up.
